coordinated_activities.activity: Sleeping with the fan running for air circulation
Waking up, using the toilet, washing face and taking a shower
Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle and toasting bread, checking phone for messages
Getting dressed and packing work bag for the day
Commuting to the nonprofit office for work
Working at the nonprofit office, coordinating community programs and meeting partner organizations
Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
Continuing work at the office, running program logistics and answering emails on the computer
Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating dinner
Cleaning up after dinner, washing dishes and tidying the counters
Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
Using the computer and desk lamp for personal admin and catching up on emails
Evening wash, brushing teeth and getting ready for bed
Winding down, reading on the phone with the fan on
